function.name: ref_solution_init_or_validate_outline
function.description: Create video/OUTLINE.md from the template if missing, else check it states the scale line and the challenge list. Runs: python3 .claude/skills/reference-solution/scripts/ref_solution.py outline <solution>. Returns one JSON object: status (ok | outline_created | solution_not_found | diagram_gate_failed | dsl_error | missing_reveal_markers | layout_gate_failed | markdown_lint_failed | render_failed | publish_failed | missing_dependency) and, when not ok, an actionable remedy.

function.name: ref_solution_render_diagrams
function.description: Render video/svg/: every C4 view (context, containers, components, version deltas V1..Vn, flows, challenge break/fix zooms, recap badges) from workspace.dsl + views.json through c4-structurizr, plus sequences, ERDs, state machines and figures from video/diagrams.py. Fails on the 1080p legibility gate or an unknown alias. Runs: python3 .claude/skills/reference-solution/scripts/ref_solution.py diagrams <solution>. Returns one JSON object: status (ok | outline_created | solution_not_found | diagram_gate_failed | dsl_error | missing_reveal_markers | layout_gate_failed | markdown_lint_failed | render_failed | publish_failed | missing_dependency) and, when not ok, an actionable remedy.

function.name: ref_solution_build_deck_and_markdown
function.description: Generate the slides and narration from video/src/*.py, run the 1080p layout gate, then generate SD-NN_<Title>_Reference_Design.md from the same source and lint it for GitHub. Runs: python3 .claude/skills/reference-solution/scripts/ref_solution.py deck, then markdown <solution>. Returns one JSON object: status (ok | outline_created | solution_not_found | diagram_gate_failed | dsl_error | missing_reveal_markers | layout_gate_failed | markdown_lint_failed | render_failed | publish_failed | missing_dependency) and, when not ok, an actionable remedy.

markdown_only.description: Skip the layout gate; only regenerate and lint the Markdown.

function.name: ref_solution_render_video
function.description: Render 1920x1080 frames by Playwright element screenshots and the narrated MP4 with sidecar .srt/.vtt captions (Kokoro TTS), with the layout gate in the same Chromium pass, frames, sentences, audio lines, the master and per-slide video segments cached by content (a re-cut re-renders only what changed), then delete every intermediate (frames, slides HTML, scripts, layout reports). Runs: python3 .claude/skills/reference-solution/scripts/ref_solution.py video <solution>. Returns one JSON object (with per-step "timings"): status (ok | outline_created | solution_not_found | diagram_gate_failed | dsl_error | missing_reveal_markers | layout_gate_failed | markdown_lint_failed | render_failed | publish_failed | missing_dependency) and, when not ok, an actionable remedy.

keep_intermediates.description: Keep frames and slides HTML for debugging.

encoder.description: x264 is the published master. videotoolbox is a hardware option; measured slower and 4x larger on slide video, so not for publishing.

verbose.description: One log line per frame, sentence, audio line and segment with its cache decision.
